newsitem.title: GERMANY: Buba urges early decision on tax, pension reform.
newsitem.headline: Buba urges early decision on tax, pension reform.

text.p: The Bundesbank on Wednesday called for an early decision on proposed reforms to German tax and pension systems, arguing that this would help to promote investment and production in the German economy.

"Rapid political decisions putting the tax and pension reform into place would make a significant contribution toward removing uncertainties about the future perspectives for investment and production in Germany," the central bank said in its 1996 annual report.
The bank argued that it was also important to create a certain environment for individuals in terms of their provision for old age.
"This is a pre-requisite for the employee to make appropriate investments at an early stage in order to strengthen private provisions, which will in future play a greater role," he said.
Bonn has so far failed to make significant progress with plans to reduce the income tax burden and prevent increases in contributions for public retirement plans.
